scientific_domain: Statistical Learning / Sparse + Low-Rank Graphical Models

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: A threshold on marginal partial correlations can reach the target without a rank-two correction.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: On the public graph, the best marginal threshold gives F1 0.836, while rank-two PCA restoration admits a threshold with F1 1.000.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The precision subtraction has off-diagonal cross-products that create or cancel apparent edges under marginalization; changing the scalar threshold cannot undo those terms.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Compare additive spectral restoration with a profiled Gaussian likelihood that re-estimates both latent directions as the sparse precision changes.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Estimating the residual scaling from raw covariance eigenvectors preserves the graph under changes of measurement units.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: A public column permutation and positive rescaling changed two symmetric adjacency entries and produced 3.36% relative precision disagreement after undoing the transformation.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Featurewise unit changes act by diagonal congruence, but raw covariance eigenspaces do not transform that way; the initial nuisance scaling therefore alters the effective sparsity penalty.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Estimate the nuisance scaling in correlation coordinates and test whether it retains the worst-slice F1 margin.
